instruction: Hide all notifications on the lock screen for privacy reasons on my Ubuntu desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling notifications on lock screen. Setup enables show-in-lock-screen (true), agent must disable it (false). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'false\n' when disabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Correct state extraction: Getter executes the right gsettings command to check lock screen notification setting
Appropriate metric: exact_match is correct for comparing boolean gsettings values
Expected value correctness: 'false\n' accurately represents the gsettings output when notifications are disabled (includes newline)
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks the single requirement from the instruction (hide notifications on lock screen)
No state timing issues: gsettings persists configuration, no UI dependency, no postconfig needed
Logical flow is sound: Setup enables notifications → Agent disables them → Evaluator verifies disabled state
